verdict.rationale: Termius offers an AI feature that converts plain-language descriptions into shell commands (termius-docs-6, termius-docs-21), which is AI-generated assistance, but there is no evidence of AI analyzing the user's own data (logs, session history, host configs) to produce insights or suggestions. missing for 10: AI-driven analysis of session logs/host data, proactive insight generation, or any recommendation engine drawing on stored user data.
